entries.title: IW Spatial Context 1.0.RC3
entries.summary: Coordinate-first free roaming, hidden spatial catalogs, typed paths and a compact AI-only local context for Infinite Worlds.

external: Host-world logic must update the $spatial_navigation tracker when authoritative movement occurs.
The two YAML source files must be compiled into the bundle before integration.
The destination world must preserve the six declared tracker variableName values or rewrite every dependent PawScript reference.
unresolved: RC3 coordinate queries and PawScript composition require Sandbox and live-world runtime certification.
Engine limits for very large hidden YAML trackers are not established.

configuration.triggerOrdering: Place host navigation commits before Refresh Spatial Context when same-pass visibility is required.

payload.name: Spatial Location Catalog
payload.description: Complete static narrative definitions for point-like locations, compiled from world-spatial.yaml.
payload.initialValue:
locations:
  southwatch_post:
    name: Southwatch Post
    kind: checkpoint
    summary: A modest road post guarding the southern approach to the Vey foothills.
    description: 'A timber guardhouse, a smithy and a low inn stand around a hard-packed
      wagon yard. Southbound traffic thins here before the open plain.

      '
    atmosphere:
    - Hammer blows from the smithy
    - Dusty wagons and tired draft animals
    - Relaxed guards who become alert after dark
    landmarks:
    - name: Southwatch Beacon
      description: A timber signal tower visible across the plain.
    services:
    - Lodging
    - Stabling
    - Smithing
    narrative_constraints:
    - The post records commercial wagons but rarely searches private travellers.
    initial_state:
      discovered: true
      visited: false
      condition: operational
      controlling_faction: royal_wardens
      temporary_changes: []
  bramble_gate:
    name: Bramble Gate
    kind: checkpoint
    summary: A guarded roadside inn and customs post where the King's Road enters
      the wooded foothills.
    description: 'Bramble Gate consists of a long stone inn, a walled stable yard
      and a squat guardhouse built against an older boundary wall. Travellers arriving
      from the south first see its lantern tower above the hawthorn hedges.

      '
    atmosphere:
    - Woodsmoke and wet leaves
    - Constant wagon traffic during daylight
    - Wary but professional road guards
    landmarks:
    - name: Lantern Tower
      description: Visible above the trees from several kilometres away.
    - name: Old Boundary Wall
      description: Predates the present kingdom and bears defaced inscriptions.
    services:
    - Lodging
    - Stabling
    - Basic repairs
    - Customs inspection
    narrative_constraints:
    - Guards record every northbound commercial wagon.
    - The checkpoint cannot be bypassed without leaving the maintained road.
    initial_state:
      discovered: true
      visited: true
      condition: operational
      controlling_faction: royal_wardens
      temporary_changes: []
  stone_bridge:
    name: Stone Bridge
    kind: landmark
    summary: A broad, old bridge carrying the King's Road across the River Vey.
    description: 'Three weathered arches cross a fast, slate-coloured river below
      wooded slopes. A narrow shrine occupies the upstream parapet.

      '
    atmosphere:
    - Constant water noise
    - Damp stone and river mist
    - Travellers slowing to inspect the road ahead
    landmarks:
    - name: Parapet Shrine
      description: A small roofed niche containing votive ribbons and river stones.
    services: []
    narrative_constraints:
    - Wagons cannot cross when the central arch is formally closed.
    initial_state:
      discovered: true
      visited: false
      condition: open
      controlling_faction: royal_wardens
      temporary_changes: []
  foxglove_post:
    name: Foxglove Post
    kind: checkpoint
    summary: A fortified inn and relay stable near the upper edge of the Blackpine
      Forest.
    description: 'Foxglove Post is built around a square courtyard with a stone inn
      on one side and a compact guard barracks on the other. Purple foxgloves grow
      along the old drainage ditches in summer.

      '
    atmosphere:
    - Resin, horse sweat and kitchen herbs
    - Bells announcing arriving couriers
    - More soldiers than civilians after sunset
    landmarks:
    - name: Relay Bell
      description: A bronze bell used to call fresh horses for royal couriers.
    services:
    - Lodging
    - Stabling
    - Courier relay
    - Guard escort requests
    narrative_constraints:
    - Fresh relay horses are reserved for credentialed couriers.
    initial_state:
      discovered: true
      visited: false
      condition: operational
      controlling_faction: royal_wardens
      temporary_changes: []

payload.name: Spatial Local Context
payload.description: Compact authoritative spatial slice for absolute position, optional current location, containing areas, nearby places and nearby or active paths.

payload.name: Spatial Context Rules
payload.content:
#SPATIAL_CONTEXT
Treat the AI-only Spatial Local Context tracked item as authoritative for absolute position, containing areas, nearby named places and nearby or active paths. A blank current_location means the player is between named places; it does not invalidate the coordinates. Use nearby_paths.relation to distinguish being on, alongside or merely near a road or waterway. Use current-location description and atmosphere only when a validated location anchor is present. Do not invent maintained roads, waterways, crossings, checkpoints, political membership or geographic access that contradicts the context. For river, creek and stream paths, increasing sequence runs downstream. A nearby entry is not necessarily visible or reachable unless terrain allows it. Never reveal undiscovered information merely because a hidden catalog contains it. When status is uninitialized, avoid precise geography until the host restores XYZ coordinates. Spatial updates committed after narration guide the following turn; do not retroactively claim that an already narrated event used newer state.

triggerEffects.name: Assemble Local Spatial Context
triggerEffects.data:
# Development source. The compiler embeds this text in the bundle's Run Script effect.
$spatial_context.package_version = "1.0.RC3"
$spatial_context.schema_version = "1.2"
$spatial_context.status = "uninitialized"
$spatial_context.position = record()
$spatial_context.current_location = record()
$spatial_context.current_areas = list()
$spatial_context.nearby_locations = list()
$spatial_context.nearby_paths = list()
$spatial_context.active_path = record()

if not $spatial_navigation.x_km.exists() or not $spatial_navigation.y_km.exists() or not $spatial_navigation.z_m.exists()
  $spatial_context.status = "uninitialized"
else
  set $position_x = $spatial_navigation.x_km
  set $position_y = $spatial_navigation.y_km
  set $position_z = $spatial_navigation.z_m
  set $settings = $spatial_geography.query_settings
  $spatial_context.status = "ready"
  $spatial_context.position.x_km = $position_x
  $spatial_context.position.y_km = $position_y
  $spatial_context.position.z_m = $position_z
  $spatial_context.position.mode = try($spatial_navigation.position_mode, "free_roam")

  # A named location is optional and is accepted only when coordinates agree.
  set $anchor_id = try($spatial_navigation.location_anchor, "")
  set $resolved_anchor_id = ""
  $spatial_context.position.location_anchor_status = "none"
  if $anchor_id != ""
    if not $spatial_geography.location_points.contains($anchor_id) or not $spatial_locations.locations.contains($anchor_id)
      $spatial_context.position.location_anchor_status = "unknown"
    else
      set $anchor_geo = $spatial_geography.location_points.item($anchor_id)
      set $anchor_dx = $anchor_geo.x_km - $position_x
      set $anchor_dy = $anchor_geo.y_km - $position_y
      set $anchor_distance = power($anchor_dx^2 + $anchor_dy^2, 0.5)
      $spatial_context.position.location_anchor_distance_km = $anchor_distance.round(2)
      if $anchor_distance <= $settings.location_anchor_tolerance_km
        set $resolved_anchor_id = $anchor_id
        set $detail = $spatial_locations.locations.item($anchor_id)
        $spatial_context.position.location_anchor_status = "at_location"
        $spatial_context.current_location.id = $anchor_id
        $spatial_context.current_location.name = $detail.name
        $spatial_context.current_location.kind = $detail.kind
        $spatial_context.current_location.summary = $detail.summary
        $spatial_context.current_location.description = try($detail.description, "")
        $spatial_context.current_location.atmosphere = try($detail.atmosphere, list())
        $spatial_context.current_location.landmarks = try($detail.landmarks, list())
        $spatial_context.current_location.services = try($detail.services, list())
        $spatial_context.current_location.narrative_constraints = try($detail.narrative_constraints, list())
        $spatial_context.current_location.state = try($spatial_location_state.locations.item($anchor_id), record())
      else
        $spatial_context.position.location_anchor_status = "out_of_range"

  # Resolve every polygonal area containing the authoritative XY coordinate.
  for each $area_id in $spatial_areas.areas.keys()
    set $area = $spatial_areas.areas.item($area_id)
    set $geometry_id = $area.geometry
    set $area_matches = false
    if $spatial_geography.spatial_index.geometry_bounds.contains($geometry_id)
      set $bounds = $spatial_geography.spatial_index.geometry_bounds.item($geometry_id)
      if $position_x >= $bounds.min_x_km and $position_x <= $bounds.max_x_km and $position_y >= $bounds.min_y_km and $position_y <= $bounds.max_y_km
        set $polygon_ids = list()
        if $spatial_geography.polygons.contains($geometry_id)
          $polygon_ids.append($geometry_id)
        else if $spatial_geography.multipolygons.contains($geometry_id)
          $polygon_ids = $spatial_geography.multipolygons.item($geometry_id).members
        for each $polygon_id in $polygon_ids
          set $polygon = $spatial_geography.polygons.item($polygon_id)
          set $inside_outer = false
          for each $edge in $polygon.runtime_outer_edges
            set $crosses = ($edge.y1_km > $position_y) != ($edge.y2_km > $position_y)
            if $crosses
              set $intersection_x = try(($edge.x2_km - $edge.x1_km) * ($position_y - $edge.y1_km) / ($edge.y2_km - $edge.y1_km) + $edge.x1_km, $edge.x1_km)
              if $position_x < $intersection_x
                $inside_outer = not $inside_outer
          if $inside_outer
            set $inside_hole = false
            for each $hole in $polygon.runtime_holes
              set $inside_this_hole = false
              for each $hole_edge in $hole.edges
                set $hole_crosses = ($hole_edge.y1_km > $position_y) != ($hole_edge.y2_km > $position_y)
                if $hole_crosses
                  set $hole_intersection_x = try(($hole_edge.x2_km - $hole_edge.x1_km) * ($position_y - $hole_edge.y1_km) / ($hole_edge.y2_km - $hole_edge.y1_km) + $hole_edge.x1_km, $hole_edge.x1_km)
                  if $position_x < $hole_intersection_x
                    $inside_this_hole = not $inside_this_hole
              if $inside_this_hole
                $inside_hole = true
            if not $inside_hole
              $area_matches = true
    if $area_matches
      set $area_context = record()
      $area_context.id = $area_id
      $area_context.name = $area.name
      $area_context.layer = $area.layer
      $area_context.kind = $area.kind
      $area_context.summary = $area.summary
      $area_context.description = try($area.description, "")
      $spatial_context.current_areas.append($area_context)

  # The compiler's sparse grid supplies candidates; exact distance filters them.
  set $cell_size = $spatial_geography.spatial_index.cell_size_km
  set $cell_x = round_down($position_x / $cell_size)
  set $cell_y = round_down($position_y / $cell_size)
  set $cell_key = $cell_x & "_" & $cell_y
  set $cell = try($spatial_geography.spatial_index.cells.item($cell_key), record())
  set $nearby_all = list()
  for each $nearby_id in try($cell.location_ids, list())
    if $nearby_id != $resolved_anchor_id and $spatial_geography.location_points.contains($nearby_id) and $spatial_locations.locations.contains($nearby_id)
      set $near_state = try($spatial_location_state.locations.item($nearby_id), record())
      if try($near_state.discovered, false)
        set $near_geo = $spatial_geography.location_points.item($nearby_id)
        set $near_dx = $near_geo.x_km - $position_x
        set $near_dy = $near_geo.y_km - $position_y
        set $near_distance = power($near_dx^2 + $near_dy^2, 0.5)
        if $near_distance <= $settings.nearby_location_radius_km
          set $near_detail = $spatial_locations.locations.item($nearby_id)
          set $near_context = record()
          set $near_direction = "nearby"
          if abs($near_dx) >= abs($near_dy) * 2
            if $near_dx > 0
              $near_direction = "east"
            else
              $near_direction = "west"
          else if abs($near_dy) >= abs($near_dx) * 2
            if $near_dy > 0
              $near_direction = "north"
            else
              $near_direction = "south"
          else if $near_dx > 0 and $near_dy > 0
            $near_direction = "northeast"
          else if $near_dx > 0 and $near_dy < 0
            $near_direction = "southeast"
          else if $near_dx < 0 and $near_dy > 0
            $near_direction = "northwest"
          else if $near_dx < 0 and $near_dy < 0
            $near_direction = "southwest"
          $near_context.id = $nearby_id
          $near_context.name = $near_detail.name
          $near_context.kind = $near_detail.kind
          $near_context.summary = $near_detail.summary
          $near_context.direction = $near_direction
          $near_context.straight_line_distance_km = $near_distance.round(2)
          $near_context.elevation_change_m = $near_geo.z_m - $position_z
          $nearby_all.append($near_context)
  $spatial_context.nearby_locations = $nearby_all.sort_by(straight_line_distance_km).first($settings.max_nearby_locations)

  # Resolve proximity to roads and waterways even when no path is active.
  set $nearby_path_all = list()
  for each $candidate_path_id in try($cell.path_ids, list())
    if $spatial_geography.paths.contains($candidate_path_id)
      set $candidate_path = $spatial_geography.paths.item($candidate_path_id)
      set $best_distance = 999999
      set $best_segment_index = 0
      set $best_projection = 0
      set $best_cumulative = 0
      set $best_side_value = 0
      for each $segment in $candidate_path.runtime_segments
        set $segment_dx = $segment.end_x_km - $segment.start_x_km
        set $segment_dy = $segment.end_y_km - $segment.start_y_km
        set $segment_length_sq = $segment_dx^2 + $segment_dy^2
        set $projection = try((($position_x - $segment.start_x_km) * $segment_dx + ($position_y - $segment.start_y_km) * $segment_dy) / $segment_length_sq, 0)
        $projection = $projection.constrain(0, 1)
        set $closest_x = $segment.start_x_km + $segment_dx * $projection
        set $closest_y = $segment.start_y_km + $segment_dy * $projection
        set $offset_x = $position_x - $closest_x
        set $offset_y = $position_y - $closest_y
        set $segment_distance = power($offset_x^2 + $offset_y^2, 0.5)
        if $segment_distance < $best_distance
          $best_distance = $segment_distance
          $best_segment_index = $segment.index
          $best_projection = $projection
          $best_cumulative = $segment.start_cumulative_km + ($segment.end_cumulative_km - $segment.start_cumulative_km) * $projection
          $best_side_value = $segment_dx * ($position_y - $segment.start_y_km) - $segment_dy * ($position_x - $segment.start_x_km)
      if $best_distance <= $settings.nearby_path_radius_km
        set $path_context = record()
        set $path_relation = "nearby"
        if $best_distance <= $settings.on_path_tolerance_km
          $path_relation = "on_path"
        else if $best_distance <= $settings.on_path_tolerance_km * 5
          $path_relation = "alongside"
        set $path_side = "center"
        if $best_side_value > 0
          $path_side = "left_of_sequence"
        else if $best_side_value < 0
          $path_side = "right_of_sequence"
        $path_context.id = $candidate_path_id
        $path_context.name = $candidate_path.name
        $path_context.type = try($candidate_path.type, "")
        $path_context.class = try($candidate_path.class, "")
        $path_context.relation = $path_relation
        $path_context.distance_km = $best_distance.round(2)
        $path_context.side = $path_side
        $path_context.nearest_segment_index = $best_segment_index
        $path_context.projected_cumulative_km = $best_cumulative.round(2)
        if $path_context.type = "river" or $path_context.type = "creek" or $path_context.type = "stream"
          $path_context.sequence_direction = "upstream_to_downstream"
        $nearby_path_all.append($path_context)
  $spatial_context.nearby_paths = $nearby_path_all.sort_by(distance_km).first($settings.max_nearby_paths)

  # Active-path progress is optional. Free-roam position remains valid without it.
  set $path_id = try($spatial_navigation.active_path, "")
  if $path_id != "" and $spatial_geography.paths.contains($path_id)
    set $path = $spatial_geography.paths.item($path_id)
    set $current_index = try($spatial_navigation.current_nav_index, 0)
    set $next_index = try($spatial_navigation.next_nav_index, 0)
    set $travel_direction = try($spatial_navigation.travel_direction, "")
    set $path_type = try($path.type, "")
    $spatial_context.active_path.id = $path_id
    $spatial_context.active_path.name = $path.name
    $spatial_context.active_path.type = $path_type
    $spatial_context.active_path.class = try($path.class, "")
    $spatial_context.active_path.surface = try($path.surface, "")
    $spatial_context.active_path.navigability = try($path.navigability, "")
    $spatial_context.active_path.travel_direction = $travel_direction
    set $active_nearby = $nearby_path_all.where(id = $path_id)
    if $active_nearby.count() > 0
      set $active_nearby_item = $active_nearby.first()
      $spatial_context.active_path.position_relation = $active_nearby_item.relation
      $spatial_context.active_path.distance_from_path_km = $active_nearby_item.distance_km
      $spatial_context.active_path.projected_cumulative_km = $active_nearby_item.projected_cumulative_km
    set $is_flowing_water = false
    if $path_type = "river" or $path_type = "creek" or $path_type = "stream"
      $is_flowing_water = true
    if $is_flowing_water
      $spatial_context.active_path.sequence_direction = "upstream_to_downstream"
      if $next_index > $current_index
        $spatial_context.active_path.flow_relation = "downstream"
      else if $next_index < $current_index
        $spatial_context.active_path.flow_relation = "upstream"
      else
        $spatial_context.active_path.flow_relation = "stationary"
    if $current_index >= 1 and $next_index >= 1 and $current_index <= $path.nav_points.count() and $next_index <= $path.nav_points.count()
      set $from_point = $path.nav_points.item($current_index)
      set $to_point = $path.nav_points.item($next_index)
      set $segment_dx = $to_point.x_km - $from_point.x_km
      set $segment_dy = $to_point.y_km - $from_point.y_km
      set $segment_dz = $to_point.z_m - $from_point.z_m
      set $horizontal_km = power($segment_dx^2 + $segment_dy^2, 0.5)
      set $distance_3d_km = power($horizontal_km^2 + ($segment_dz / 1000)^2, 0.5)
      set $grade_pct = try(($segment_dz / ($horizontal_km * 1000)) * 100, 0)
      set $absolute_grade = abs($grade_pct)
      set $slope_character = "approximately level"
      if $absolute_grade >= 10
        if $grade_pct > 0
          $slope_character = "very steep ascent"
        else
          $slope_character = "very steep descent"
      else if $absolute_grade >= 6
        if $grade_pct > 0
          $slope_character = "steep ascent"
        else
          $slope_character = "steep descent"
      else if $absolute_grade >= 3
        if $grade_pct > 0
          $slope_character = "noticeable ascent"
        else
          $slope_character = "noticeable descent"
      else if $absolute_grade >= 1
        if $grade_pct > 0
          $slope_character = "gentle ascent"
        else
          $slope_character = "gentle descent"
      $spatial_context.active_path.segment_horizontal_km = $horizontal_km.round(2)
      $spatial_context.active_path.segment_3d_km = $distance_3d_km.round(2)
      $spatial_context.active_path.elevation_change_m = $segment_dz
      $spatial_context.active_path.average_grade_pct = $grade_pct.round(2)
      $spatial_context.active_path.slope_character = $slope_character
      set $waypoint_index = try($spatial_navigation.next_waypoint_nav_index, 0)
      if $waypoint_index >= 1 and $waypoint_index <= $path.nav_points.count()
        set $waypoint_point = $path.nav_points.item($waypoint_index)
        set $waypoint_location_id = try($waypoint_point.location_id, "")
        if $waypoint_location_id != "" and $spatial_locations.locations.contains($waypoint_location_id)
          set $waypoint_state = try($spatial_location_state.locations.item($waypoint_location_id), record())
          if try($waypoint_state.discovered, false)
            set $waypoint_detail = $spatial_locations.locations.item($waypoint_location_id)
            $spatial_context.active_path.next_waypoint_known = true
            $spatial_context.active_path.next_waypoint_id = $waypoint_location_id
            $spatial_context.active_path.next_waypoint_name = $waypoint_detail.name
            $spatial_context.active_path.next_waypoint_role = try($waypoint_point.role, "")
            $spatial_context.active_path.distance_to_waypoint_km = abs($waypoint_point.cumulative_km - $from_point.cumulative_km).round(2)
          else
            $spatial_context.active_path.next_waypoint_known = false
